svg.title: Puzzle 20: The Granny's Downfall - Solved and refused
svg.desc: Left: the square-knot loop lies fully seated in the mold board channel, passing under all six bridges, marked with a check. Right: the granny-knot loop follows the same outline and seats its neck and first clump, but its second clump is wrong-handed, so all three of its crossings ride proud over their bridges instead of threading the tunnels; it cannot seat, marked with a cross.
svg.text: its three crossings are wrong-handed — they ride
proud over the bridges instead of threading under
